verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing mentions flexible payroll timing ("Run payroll on your schedule... process payroll as often as you need") which implies configurable pay schedules, but there is no explicit documentation of setting up distinct weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly schedules per team or department. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple concurrent pay schedule types, per-team/group schedule assignment, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of this configuration.
